name: Algorithmiq Oy
description: Algorithmiq develops quantum algorithms for life sciences and drug discovery applications. The company focuses on creating quantum-enhanced computational methods for molecular simulations and pharmaceutical research. Algorithmiq combines quantum computing expertise with domain knowledge in chemistry and biology to accelerate drug development.

news.title: Algorithmiq raises €18M and moves global headquarters from Helsinki to Milan
news.excerpt: United Ventures and CDP Venture Capital co-led a €18M round for Algorithmiq, bringing total funding to €36M. The company simultaneously relocated its global HQ from Helsinki to Milan — Italy's largest-ever VC investment in a quantum startup — citing proximity to European enterprise customers and institutional investors.

news.title: IBM and Algorithmiq demonstrate quantum advantage in trusted materials simulation beyond classical verification
news.excerpt: On July 30, 2026, IBM and Algorithmiq announced a joint framework for validating quantum computations when classical verification is unavailable, demonstrating quantum advantage in simulating a heterogeneous quantum material on IBM's Heron processors. Algorithmiq simultaneously released a new benchmark for quantum advantage claims.
